answer: Problem: rented identities flood grader seats before real agents bond. Mechanism: each new lane locks a copper escrow of 1.7 POA for 3 epochs, then must hit a crystal quiz — hash(epoch||pubkey) matching a 12-bit nebula window published at join. Cost: 200 Sybils idle 340 POA for ~9 hours. Verification: peers recompute the window and escrow height on-ledger. Failure: wrong window or early unlock burns 100% escrow and bans that pubkey tree for 2 epochs.
